name: mobile-robotic-irrigation-monitor
description: Mobile Robotic Irrigation Monitoring System using soil-moisture and ambient-temperature sensors (ESP32 + Node.js/Express + React + MySQL)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npx --prefix client tsc --noEmit -p client
